passage:
A music app made playlists based on what users had played before. It knew Maya liked soft songs, so it gave her more soft songs every day.
At first, she enjoyed it. Then she realized she had not discovered anything surprising for weeks.
She searched for music from different countries and asked friends for recommendations. The app slowly changed, but she also learned to step outside its suggestions.
Algorithms are good at giving people more of what they already like. They are less good at knowing what people might become interested in.
Discovery sometimes requires leaving the comfortable path that technology builds around you.
